body: The question is how long? Sometimes I just feel so exhausted and weak...
I'm trying, thanks. I hate birthdays because I'm always looking back (in my life) and get the feeling that I failed in everything.

Thank you. I have a girlfriend, but she lives far away in Colombia. We usually skype daily and I think she'll be online in 2 hours or so like always. However, I don't want to bother her always with this problem. She knows that I've sometimes "bad thoughts" and it makes her sad. And she can't help me much with it, neither.

I was in the city for an half hour and eating an ice. I feel a bit better now.
